verdict.rationale: WooCommerce's own feature docs say that beyond its bundled payment methods there are 140 region-specific gateways to choose from, including Stripe, PayPal, Square and Amazon Pay. That covers the gateway-choice half of the story, but nothing in the pack shows charging in multiple currencies. Missing for 10: any evidence of multi-currency pricing or charging, details on configuring and switching gateways, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can choose among third-party payment gateways and charge in multiple currencies when the built-in option doesn't fit

citations.quote: there are 140 region-specific gateways to choose from and integrate with, including WooPayments, Stripe, PayPal, Square, and Amazon Pay
Woo comes bundled with the ability to accept major credit cards, bank transfers (BACS), checks, and cash on delivery. Beyond the basics, there are 140 region-specific gateways
